scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run test && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.deploy:pages: set XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.\.wrangler&& set WRANGLER_CACHE_DIR=.\.wrangler\cache&& npm --prefix api exec -- wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name spris
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:pages
scripts.security:audit: npm audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix api audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev
scripts.security:audit:full: npm audit && npm --prefix api audit && npm --prefix frontend audit
